calendar/testSearchEvent.reason: 1.0 indexes calendar text asynchronously; a search right after a PUT can miss
calendar/testSearchEvent.source: Pinned tests/test_caldav.py:2690-2815: testSearchEvent recreates its calendar, PUTs three events and text-searches their summaries at once. At 1.0 an ordinary account's calendar text search reads the search index, written after the PUT: a text-match calendar-query right after each of 20 PUTs found the event 3 times, and within 5 s 20 times. Failures seen at lines 2793 and 2804; 2810 and 2815 are the same searches. A per-test retry (ruling 167) failed all three attempts, since each attempt recreates the calendar and searches right after its PUTs. Key mode searches in memory and stays a required pass.

flows/test_delegation_and_organizer_medi.reason: 1.0 refuses a delegator-forwarded REQUEST (sender must be the organizer)
flows/test_delegation_and_organizer_medi.source: Upstream 1.0.1 crates/groupware/src/calendar/itip.rs:174-181 refuses a REQUEST whose sender is not the organizer, while its attendee path (scheduling/attendee.rs, "Invite new delegates") sends the delegate's REQUEST from the delegator; server log: calendar.itip-message-error "Sender is not the organizer". Carol's poll at tests/caldav_client/test_flows.py:164 times out. Key mode invites the delegate through the organizer-side drain and stays a required pass.
